productFit.name: Manfrotto 055 Aluminum 3-Section Tripod with Horizontal Column (MT055XPRO3)
productFit.metricSpecs: Maker (manfrotto.com global-de): max height 170 cm, max height with centre column down 140 cm, min height 9 cm, closed length 61 cm, weight 2.5 kg, 3 leg sections, flip locks, 3/8" top screw; safety payload 20 kg under UNI/PdR 105:2021 (this matches the B&H 44 lb table figure; the post keeps the lower ~9 kg working load).
productFit.reason: Manfrotto sells it in the EU under the same model code (German maker page, EU dealers; amazon.nl sells the same ASIN in stock).

productFit.name: K&F Concept 90 inch Tripod
productFit.metricSpecs: Maker spec table: 230 cm max, 1620 mm (162 cm) without centre column, 10 kg load. EU Amazon listing of the same ASIN: 66.5 cm to 230 cm, 54 cm folded, 4 leg sections, 28 mm ball head, model T254A7+BH-28L.
productFit.reason: Same ASIN is listed on the Dutch Amazon store as the K&F Concept 230 cm tripod (T254A7+BH-28L).

productFit.name: VICTIV 74 inch Camera Tripod
productFit.metricSpecs: amazon.nl listing (same ASIN): 74 in / 188 cm, 19.5 in min, about 1.36-1.4 kg, 3 leg sections. Its load field (6.35 kg) disagrees with the maker page (9.5 lb), so the post keeps the lower 9.5 lb (4.3 kg).
productFit.reason: amazon.nl has a page for the same ASIN (model NT70) but shows "Momenteel niet verkrijgbaar" (currently unavailable).

productFit.name: CAMBOFOTO 74 inch Camera Tripod
productFit.metricSpecs: amazon.nl listing (same ASIN): 20 to 188 cm, about 1.3 kg (1.27 kg in the spec table), 8.8 lb load (its text also says 4 kg), folded 20.47 in, 3 leg sections.

localFacts.fact: CBS: Dutch-born men aged 19 were on average 182.9 cm tall in 2020 (women 169.3 cm), i.e. the average young Dutch man is already at the 6 ft (183 cm) mark of this post.
KLM: hand baggage, including handles and wheels, max. 55 x 35 x 25 cm. The Manfrotto (61 cm closed) does not fit lengthwise; the K&F (54 cm folded) just fits.
Rijksmuseum: visitors may photograph and film without disturbing others; for bridal photography the museum explicitly states "geen statieven en geen extra belichting".
Manfrotto maker spec sheet: 170 cm max, 140 cm with the centre column down, 61 cm closed, 2.5 kg.

localPainPoints.pain: Very tall Dutch photographers need a tripod that reaches close to 2 m including hiking boots, and want to stand upright without the centre column.
localPainPoints.fix: Pick by column-down height; only the K&F publishes 162 cm column down.

quotes.text: Inclusief de dikke zolen van de wandelschoenen tik ikzelf bijna de 2 meter aan.

localPainPoints.pain: Tall tripods have very thin lowest leg sections, which hurts stability.
localPainPoints.fix: Keep the thinnest sections partly retracted and hang a bag on the hook (post advice for the K&F, VICTIV and CAMBOFOTO).

quotes.text: Bij hoge statieven zijn de onderste poten soms wel heel erg dun.

localPainPoints.pain: Tall gear that is also light is hard to find (Tweakers forum, for a 1.96 m photographer).
localPainPoints.fix: The VICTIV and CAMBOFOTO weigh about 1.3-1.4 kg for 188 cm, with the load limits the post states.

quotes.text: Maar nu zijn er weinig monopods die lang en licht zijn.

localGain.point: CBS average height (182.9 cm for 19-year-old men): the 6 ft threshold is the Dutch average.
KLM hand-baggage limit 55 x 35 x 25 cm versus folded lengths.
Rijksmuseum tripod note (no tripods for bridal shoots).
Maker metric figures for the Manfrotto (170 / 140 cm).
